# LionSec Hub

> LionSec Hub is a global cybersecurity, quantum-safe security and digital resilience organisation
> providing advanced security solutions, research, intelligence, engineering and workforce
> development for financial institutions, governments, defence organisations, critical
> infrastructure operators and enterprises. Registered in Nigeria (CAC BN 9458297).
> Securing critical systems. Protecting digital economies. Preparing for the quantum era.
> Remote-first, internationally oriented delivery from Lagos, Nigeria.

## Services (nine divisions - /services)
- /service-cyber-defence - penetration testing, SOC readiness, SIEM, detection engineering, threat hunting, DFIR readiness
- /quantum-security - post-quantum cryptography (NIST FIPS 203/204/205), QKD advisory, quantum-safe architecture, cryptographic agility, PQC migration
- /service-ai-security - LLM security, AI red teaming, agent security, RAG pipelines, AI governance (NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM, ISO/IEC 42001 awareness)
- /service-offensive-security - advanced offensive security, red/purple teaming, controlled exploit development, malware analysis, reverse engineering (authorised work only)
- /service-defence - lawful, authorised defensive cybersecurity for defence and national-security sectors (no military contracts or classified access claimed)
- /data-protection - data protection architecture, DLP, encryption & key management, privacy engineering, GDPR/NDPA advisory, ISO/IEC 27701 awareness
- /service-financial-intelligence - banking/fintech security, payment API security, fraud controls, BEC defence, lawful financial-crime intelligence
- /service-grc - ISMS/PIMS/AIMS advisory, ISO 27001/27701/42001 readiness, risk assessment, audit evidence preparation (LionSec does not issue certifications)
- /service-secure-engineering - secure application architecture, cloud security (AWS/Azure), DevSecOps, Zero Trust, OT/ICS engineering

## Industries (/industries)
- /industry-banking - Banking & Finance
- /industry-defence - Defence & National Security (authorised defensive work only)
- /industry-government - Government
- /industry-telecoms - Telecommunications

## Academy
One Academy with six subject categories: Cybersecurity, AI & AI Security, Cloud &
Infrastructure Security, Cryptography & Quantum-Safe Security, Governance/Risk/Privacy,
and Programming & Secure Engineering - plus Corporate & Institutional Academy (B2B).
Instructor-led, proof-based programmes with honest status labels (Available, Upcoming,
Research Programme). Tuition in NGN (Cybersecurity Foundations ₦350,000; Cybersecurity
Technical Fast-Track ₦250,000); international pricing on request.

## Curriculum
/curriculum - readable student curricula with locations: Nigeria, Ghana, Egypt, Rwanda.
Personalised programmes: SOC analyst pathway, developer-to-security, IoT/AI/cloud security,
AI security engineering & LLM red teaming, foundation recovery and advanced SOC capstone.
